youHint: That's you · click to change your look

panel.pitch: Share this office with your team: see each other walk around and how many agents everyone has working. Your prompts, files and tools stay on your computer.
panel.inviteCode: Invite code — share it with teammates
panel.rotate: Generate a new code (the old one stops working)
panel.privacy: Teammates only see your character and your number of running agents.
panel.pitchMore: Create another team office, or join one with an invite code.

dialog.createBody: You'll get an invite code to share. Everyone who joins sees the same office.
dialog.joinBody: Enter the invite code a teammate shared with you. You only need to do this once.
dialog.serverHint: Leave as is unless your team runs its own relay.
dialog.serverRequired: Enter your team's relay address (see docs/TEAM.md to deploy one).
dialog.serverInvalid: Use an https:// address (http:// is allowed only for 127.0.0.1).
dialog.privacy: 🔒 Shared with the team: your nickname, your character and where it stands, and how many of your agents are running. Never shared: prompts, files, tools, project paths or anything else from Claude Code.

editor.title: My character
editor.body: This is you in the office. In a team office your teammates see this look and nickname.

card.memberPrivate: {{name}}'s Claude Code activity is private. You can see their character and how many agents they have running.
card.agentPrivate: This is one of {{name}}'s agents. What it's working on stays private to {{name}}.

hints.title: Walk around
hints.move: WASD or click the floor to walk
hints.use: Click a chair, sofa or arcade to use it · E to use / get up

error.network: Couldn't reach the relay server. Check your connection and the server address.
error.server: The relay server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
error.no_server: Set the relay server address first.
error.invalid_code: That invite code doesn't match any team office.
error.rate_limited: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.bad_request: Please check the names you entered.
error.unauthorized: This team office no longer exists or your membership ended.
error.forbidden: Only the person who created the office can do that.
error.not_found: The relay server doesn't recognise this request — is the address right?
error.version: This version of Agentville is too old for the team server. Please update.

place.lobbyHint: walk through a door to enter an office
